description: Re-submit the WHOLE current corpus against an existing master: the server diffs by unit id and answers with {units, versions[], delta_block_ids} — pass delta_block_ids VERBATIM as group_run_start.block_ids to run only the delta. Unchanged units keep their translations. Synchronous, bills nothing.

document.description: The WHOLE current .tstrings.json corpus inline (same shape as strings_import). Units missing from it are removed.

document_id.description: The master document the corpus was first imported as.

overwrite_targets.description: Let the corpus’s targets overwrite translations Transept already holds for changed units (default false).

name: strings_reimport
title: Re-import strings corpus
